records.scope: Flask application implementing the tourradar.com mirror: homepage with search widget and mega menus, destination / style / region / place / collection / deals landing pages, scored search, SERP with the upstream filter set (duration, price, adventure styles, must-see cities, start/end city, guide type, tour type, physical rating, operators, instant confirmation, age range), tour detail with itinerary accordion, included / not-included, Good to Know, traveler moments, reviews with subratings and operator replies, Q&A with ask-the-operator, dates & prices with sold-out / guaranteed / instant-confirmation departures, the 7-step booking flow (travelers, room selection, traveler details, travel insurance, promo codes, payment schedule, card payment) with confirmation and Tour Management, wishlist hearts, accounts, booking cancellation, review writing and platform reviews.

Deterministic build-time and boot-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data_*.json snapshots captured from tourradar.com on 2026-09-27: tours with itineraries, departures, reviews, Q&A and good-to-know, operators, destinations with landing copy, traveler moments, platform reviews and promo codes, plus the four benchmark users with bookings, wishlists and reviews. Seeding is idempotent (whole-function gates) and byte-reproducible under PYTHONHASHSEED=0.

Frozen snapshot of every harvested tour record as served by tourradar.com on 2026-09-27: name, operator, duration, start/end city, rating, review count and subratings, prices and discounts, style and attribute rows, group size and age range, day-by-day itinerary with included and optional activities, meals, landmarks and start points, departure dates with status / prices / guarantees, traveler reviews with guide names and operator replies, customer Q&A and Good to Know (currencies, plugs, vaccines, visa).

Frozen snapshot of the operators (rating, review counts, headquarters, response rate and time, badges, logos) and the destination taxonomy (countries, regions, places, styles, collections, deals) with the landing-page copy and hero media the live pages serve.
Frozen snapshot of homepage traveler moments and the promo codes modeled on the upstream Escape Sale and TourRadar+ programs.
Per-file inventory (bytes, SHA-256, upstream source URL) for all 3715 managed image files under static/images. Verified byte- and hash-exact by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py at build time.
Real tour photography served by cdn.tourradar.com at the 360x210 (card), 430x252 and 720x480 (gallery) transforms the live tour and search pages render.
Real traveler photos attached to tour reviews, served by cdn.tourradar.com at the transforms the review cards render.
Real traveler avatars (100x100 / 50x50) served by cdn.tourradar.com for review and moment authors.
Real traveler moments media served by cdn.tourradar.com at the 480p / 1080p renditions the moments strips render.
Real operator logos served by cdn.tourradar.com at the 206x150 transform the operator panels render.
Real destination hero photography served by cdn.tourradar.com at the 750x400 transform the destination landing pages render.

Real site chrome from the live homepage: hero and spotlight art from assets-page-editor.tourradar.com, the style tiles from cdn.tourradar.com serp transforms, the footer trust badges (Trustpilot, WYSE, ASTA, TICO, USTOA, CLIA, Adventure Travel) and the favicon.

Hand-written stylesheet reproducing the captured tourradar.com design language (primary #177fa4, hover #0e6d8d, text #323637, borders #c7d0d9/#e3e5e6, light bg #f1f2f3, Helvetica/Arial, 32px pill CTAs, tour cards, filter panel, booking steps, footer).

Shared front-end behaviour: mega menus, debounced destination autocomplete against /api/suggest, itinerary accordion with expand-all, dates panel toggle, room and insurance selection, traveler stepper, search submit.

Jinja2 templates mirroring the live page structures: base with promo bar, trust strip, mega-menu header and footer; homepage; destination/style/region/place/collection/deals/solo landings; SERP with filters; tour detail; 7-step booking; confirmation; login/signup; account and profile; wishlist; operator pages; moments; platform reviews; static info pages; 404.
22 goal-style benchmark tasks (34-95 words) across 14 feature domains; honest walkthroughs span 15-40+ recorded browser steps.
